objective: Define the narrow boundary for connecting a real Verilator-facing process parse result to the existing sidecar launcher without treating the bridge as direct Verilator sidecar execution, broad native option support, runtime/ABI change, timing evidence, or arbitrary filelist support.

reason: the prior review accepted only a launcher run from reviewed process-to-launcher fixture metadata
the next useful boundary is a real Verilator-facing process parse plus explicit sidecar context before launcher start
an in-process Verilator callback or runtime/ABI extension would be a larger implementation and claim surface
a generated command handoff alone would repeat the already reviewed metadata path without adding process evidence
wrapper-mediated process launch can preserve separate parser, bridge, launcher, sidecar stage, compare, and timing failure classes
definition_decision.weakest_point: A wrapper-mediated bridge is still not direct Verilator sidecar execution. It may prove that a Verilator-facing process accepted the expanded native option spelling and that a reviewed wrapper started the existing launcher, but it does not prove Verilator internals executed sidecar stages, broad native option support, runtime/ABI integration, arbitrary filelist support, automatic allocation, timing, raw-state equality, or production throughput.

failure_class_boundary.verilator_process_parse_failure: the Verilator-facing process rejects or fails before expanded accelerator options are accepted
failure_class_boundary.missing_explicit_sidecar_context: target/template/shape/source context is absent before bridge or launcher start
failure_class_boundary.source_or_template_authority_failure: reviewed source closure or template authority is absent or mismatched for pulp_ita_mha 64x1
failure_class_boundary.process_to_launcher_bridge_failure: the reviewed parser/process payload cannot be converted into the exact structured launcher CLI argv
failure_class_boundary.launcher_cli_invocation_failure: the bridge attempts to start the existing launcher from structured argv but cannot start or complete launcher invocation safely
failure_class_boundary.sidecar_stage_failure: the launcher starts, but a scoped build or run stage fails before compare
failure_class_boundary.compare_failure: coverage_output_equivalence compare runs and records a mismatch
failure_class_boundary.timing_claim_without_measurement: timing or speedup is claimed without a separate timing gate

required_next_gate.name: review_verilator_native_option_parser_direct_command_path_native_invocation_verilator_process_launcher_bridge_boundary_gate
must_decide: whether wrapper-mediated process launch is the narrowest acceptable bridge kind after the reviewed process-to-launcher CLI run
whether Verilator process parse evidence, reviewed fixture metadata, explicit sidecar context, launcher argv, sidecar stages, and compare evidence stay separate
whether in-process Verilator callbacks and runtime/ABI changes remain deferred
whether generated command handoff alone is insufficient as the next implementation boundary
whether failure classes remain distinguishable before any future run
whether timing, automatic allocation, arbitrary filelist support, raw-state equality, and production throughput remain out of scope

non_claims: not broad native Verilator option support
reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
